title: Securities and Instrument Review
outcome: Classify an instrument and understand the documented terms before relying on it.

steps.title: Identify the instrument type

lines.text: Read the instrument for its maker, payee, amount, payment terms, signatures, and any stated conditions.

speed_bumps: A label alone does not determine whether a document is a negotiable instrument or a security.

steps.title: Use indorsement vocabulary carefully

lines.text: An indorsement may include language such as “without recourse,” which can affect an indorser's liability under applicable UCC rules.

speed_bumps: Indorsement language does not replace the instrument's other terms or the parties' governing agreement.

steps.title: Separate disputed discharge claims from payment methods

lines.text: Claims that a privately created instrument automatically discharges a public debt are disputed and should be treated as an inventory item, not a payment method.

speed_bumps: Confirm accepted payment methods directly with the creditor or agency before relying on any submission.
flags: IRS IRM 25.25.10 addresses frivolous submissions; presenting a fictitious instrument as payment can create serious compliance risk.
